computation: Exact mathematical integer sum; intermediate sums must not wrap, saturate or reject valid final sums.

result.success: OK with exact sum as canonical decimal string and input count
result.overflow: DOMAIN_ERROR with SUM_OUT_OF_I64_RANGE if final exact sum is outside signed int64

retry: Repeated pure computation is permitted; publication and rewards require a separate deduplication contract.
cancellation: A cancellation known to the result verifier rejects the candidate; this does not prove process termination.
scope: BOUNDED_LOCAL_RESEARCH; no remote execution or untrusted-code isolation
